name: Residence for Investment in Quality of Retired/Pensioned (Pensionado)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a minimum monthly pension or retirement income of US$1,500 from government, official, or private foreign sources, plus US$250/month for each dependent.
Requires a bank letter confirming a Dominican bank account, and pension certification from the paying employer, translated into Spanish.

evidence_required.document: Pension certification from the paying employer, translated to Spanish
Medical exam from a DGM-authorized institution

sources.title: Dirección General de Migración -- Residence for Investment in Quality of Retired or Pensioned: US$1,500/month base + US$250/month per dependent, 90 working days, RD$38,600 total fees

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Dominican Republic). Note the MIREX consular Residence Visa (RS) page independently cites the same US$1,500/month pensioner figure, cross-confirming this threshold across two separate tier-1 government sources. Processing time (90 working days) is notably longer than the Rentista route's 45 working days despite similar documentation -- a real, DGM-stated difference worth surfacing.
